items.name: Socratis
items.summary: Live coding interviews combining WebRTC voice, a Monaco editor, and contextual AI feedback.

details.title: Real-time code awareness
details.body: Earlier versions hallucinated about the candidate's code. V3's fix was Chat Context Injection: every edit in the Monaco editor pushes an explicit system message into the agent's context, so the model literally sees every diff instead of guessing.

items.name: Waldo
items.summary: Multimodal PDF retrieval across text, tables, and figures, with query routing and retrieval review.

details.title: Ingestion pipeline
bullets: IBM Docling extracts document structure with high fidelity
RapidOCR falls back for scanned pages
Gemini VLM transcribes figures to searchable semantic text
Sentence Transformers (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) embed chunks into Qdrant

items.name: Vaani
items.summary: A voice-agent prototype with call orchestration, live transcripts, and configurable conversation personas.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Connects a FastAPI call API to LiveKit voice sessions and a React monitoring interface.
Explores interruption handling, live transcription, and conversation-event tags. The demo does not establish measured latency or regulatory compliance.

items.name: BranchGPT
items.summary: Branch and merge AI conversations while preserving the context of each path.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Stores branched message histories with PostgreSQL and Drizzle.
Merges branch-specific messages through a generated summary while retaining the shared conversation history.

items.name: MapMyRepo
items.summary: Explore repository structure as a D3 graph, with file summaries and contextual questions.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Imports public GitHub repositories or locally selected folders into a navigable file graph.
Uses D3 for node layout and Gemini for contextual file summaries and questions.

items.name: Forge
items.summary: A curated coding-agent workflow plugin with local activity logging and optional cross-session memory.

details.title: Falsifiable, not aspirational
bullets: tdd: no production code without a failing test first — watch it fail, delete pre-test code
debug: after 3 failed fixes, question the architecture
verify: a claim → required-proof table before 'done' is allowed
Each skill names the rationalization it forbids, so the agent can't talk itself out of the process

items.name: LeetBot
items.summary: A browser extension for coding hints, solution planning, and zoomable explanation diagrams.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Offers separate hint, tutor, and solution-planning modes in a browser extension.
Renders Mermaid explanations in a movable, resizable interface alongside the coding problem.

items.name: DryRunVisualised
items.summary: Inspect algorithm execution through editor state, variables, and 2D/3D visualizations.

details.title: Execution pipeline
bullets: Python runs client-side in Pyodide (WebAssembly)
C++ compiles remotely via Godbolt Compiler Explorer API (GCC 14.1)
Instrumentation injects `sys.settrace` (Python) and stderr macros (C++)
Each line emits a JSON snapshot: `{ line, stack, heap, stdout }`
`vizDetector.ts` classifies variables (array/grid/graph/linked-list/tree/scalar) and routes them

items.name: PolySEE
items.summary: A team campus-chatbot prototype exploring multilingual answers grounded in university documents.

details.title: RAG pipeline
bullets: Query embedded via local Ollama models
Semantic search over institutional documents in ChromaDB
Retrieved context + user query sent to Gemini Flash 2.0
Response returned with confidence score and source context

items.name: A18-INFINION-
items.summary: A multi-agent static-analysis experiment for specialized C++ and API misuse.

details.title: Context-first design
details.body: Before any LLM sees the code, the MCP Lookup Agent queries an MCP server (FastMCP + BGE embeddings) against the RDI API documentation and pulls the relevant rules. Only then does the Bug Detector run — with the API manual already in context.

items.name: SSS
items.summary: Organize screenshots with a local vision model and searchable per-image Markdown notes.

details.title: Pipeline
bullets: Vision model (Qwen2-VL-2B via Transformers/PyTorch) ingests each image → structured understanding
Classifier routes to one of nine categories — anime, tech, hiring, finance, learning, health, news, memes, misc
Link extractor pulls every URL in the image
Text cleaner strips hashtags, emojis, formatting noise
Per-image .txt log in `./output/extracted/` + master `links.md` index

items.name: RupeeRoast
items.summary: A bank-statement analysis prototype with transaction categorization, charts, and generated commentary.

details.title: Extraction
bullets: PyMuPDF4LLM as the primary parser — much better than plain PyPDF for complex layouts
PyPDF as fallback for edge cases
Pydantic-validated schemas throughout

items.name: NyaySaathi
items.summary: A legal-information retrieval prototype with document ingestion and corpus-based answers.

details.title: Retrieval engine
bullets: Embedded local Qdrant — no server or Docker needed
Query expansion via a hand-tuned Constitution-to-statute link map (e.g. IT Act 69A → Article 19(2))
Reranking by exact article/section matches, number proximity and keyword overlap
13-language layer: script detection + Hinglish heuristics, English-pivot retrieval, translate-back answers

items.name: EmailDrafter
items.summary: Draft and refine emails from user context, tone, and length preferences.

details.title: API surface
bullets: POST /api/draft — { prompt, tone?, length? } → { draft }
POST /api/refine — { draft, instructions } → { draft }

items.name: Korosuke
items.summary: A PyQt sidebar for chatting with local Ollama models using background inference.

details.title: Details
bullets: PyQt5 with smooth slide animations and styled chat bubbles
Background QThread worker — UI never freezes during generation
PID-based hotkey toggle: re-running the script flips visibility
ESC hides the sidebar

items.name: ASCIIRealTime
items.summary: Convert webcam frames into live ASCII or emoji art with optional background segmentation.

details.title: Modes
bullets: ASCII text — `<pre>` with dynamically-sized font
Emoji — `<canvas>` grid with per-glyph bitmap caching for alignment
Palettes: Basic, Extended, Blocks, Emoji, Custom

items.name: PixelForge
items.summary: A JavaFX image-to-ASCII tool with live previews, color rendering, and PNG export.

details.title: Output
details.body: Full-color mode samples the original image's pixel colors and applies them per-character, creating the illusion of the original image through typography. Download triggers a dedicated HD render pass at the source image's original resolution — so a 4K input gives you a 4K ASCII PNG, not a screenshot.

items.name: GitArt
items.summary: Paint a contribution-grid design and export a Git repository assembled in the browser.

details.title: Everything runs in the browser
bullets: isomorphic-git on a memfs virtual filesystem
JSZip packages .git/ + files into a single zip
No server writes, no GitHub API calls, no fake identities

items.name: GhostSync
items.summary: A remote-IDE experiment connecting Telegram controls, screenshots, and a private tunnel.

details.title: How the bridge works
bullets: Auto-downloads `cloudflared.exe` and spawns a Cloudflare Tunnel
python-telegram-bot listens for authorized commands
PyAutoGUI automates IDE input (window detection via %LOCALAPPDATA%)
CustomTkinter GUI; single PyInstaller .exe for non-Python users

items.name: BranchGPT-Extension
items.summary: Explore branched ChatGPT conversations in a browser side panel with local IndexedDB storage.

details.title: Tech
bullets: Vite + CRXJS — Manifest V3 native build
React + TypeScript + Tailwind
Dexie.js over IndexedDB for local storage

items.name: Health-os
items.summary: A mobile-first workout and meal dashboard interface.

details.title: The layout trick
details.body: Whole page is locked to `h-[100dvh]` with `overflow-hidden` on the outer body. Only the workout list and meal list scroll internally. On mobile, `100dvh` handles the browser chrome properly so the app uses the full available screen at all times.

items.name: Kyoka
items.summary: An experimental multi-agent interface for summarizing public web research into briefing cards.

details.title: Tri-agent pipeline
bullets: Deep Diver (Tavily Search) — OSINT across LinkedIn, GitHub, X, YouTube
PsychProfiler (DeepSeek-V3 / Gemini) — DISC, Big-Five, archetypes, ego hooks
Strategist (GPT-4o / Gemini) — Battle Card with DOs, DON'Ts, opening lines

items.name: Maze-Pathfinder-Visualizer
items.summary: Compare BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, and A* as they explore generated mazes.

details.title: Color coding
bullets: Blue — BFS explored cells
Red — DFS explored cells
Green — Dijkstra explored cells
Yellow — A* explored cells
Orange — final shortest path

items.name: weather-dashboard-ai
items.summary: Combine weather data with model-generated clothing and activity suggestions.

details.title: Reliability
details.body: Constrained JSON-only prompting means the LLM can't free-form — parsing the response into typed fields is deterministic.

items.name: ChatBotUI
items.summary: A college-assistant interface with student chat and document-management views.

details.title: Architecture
details.body: Shared `ThemeContext` and `useTheme` hook keep all three portals visually consistent through dark/light switches. A root layout wraps everything in the theme provider; `AppRouter.jsx` handles portal-level navigation.

items.name: Arohan
items.summary: A React dashboard experiment with charts and animated interactions.

details.title: Honest framing
details.body: An OpenAI listing at ~$1T would be ~6x the largest IPO in history, so the comparables regression is an anchor, not statistics-grade inference — every band is labelled probability-weighted, with wide error bars and caveats baked into each research file. A research exercise, not investment advice.

items.name: fastapi-cheatsheet
items.summary: A Markdown and PDF reference covering FastAPI routing, validation, security, databases, and testing.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Covers request models, routing, dependencies, authentication examples, middleware, databases, and tests.
Published in Markdown and PDF; its reference link was merged into EbookFoundation/free-programming-books.

items.name: Folder-Summary-Parser
items.summary: A Tkinter utility for file counts, folder sizes, and extension breakdowns.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Recursively counts files and folders and summarizes storage by extension.
Uses a Tkinter interface and handles inaccessible paths during traversal.

items.name: habiTurtle
items.summary: A PyQt habit tracker with local JSON history, streaks, and a reactive turtle mascot.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Records habit completion in local JSON and derives a daily streak.
A PyQt mascot changes its visual state with progress.

items.name: RealTimeMemoryAllocationSimulator
items.summary: A single-page browser experiment for visualizing memory allocation.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Built as a standalone HTML browser simulation.
An early systems-learning exercise with no server setup.

items.name: HoleEmAll
items.summary: A Pygame arcade experiment built around cursor movement, collisions, and a countdown.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Uses a Pygame update loop for mouse movement, collision detection, growth, and scoring.
A countdown and completion state turn the mechanics into a small playable arcade loop.

items.name: MaintMaster
items.summary: A static interface exploring maintenance scheduling and task tracking.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: A single-page maintenance interface for schedules, checklists, and status.
An early frontend prototype rather than a released team-management service.

items.name: CultureCompass
items.summary: An early single-page experiment around cultural information and storytelling.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: A single-page cultural-information and storytelling experiment.
Explores content presentation in static HTML and CSS.

items.name: sidz-cafe
items.summary: A restaurant website with a JSON-backed menu and client-side shopping-cart interface.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Uses JSON menu data across food-category pages.
Includes a browser-side cart and a map in a static restaurant website.

items.name: air-aware-website
items.summary: An educational air-quality website with environmental resources and external AQI links.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Presents pollution case studies, practical resources, and links to external AQI information.
Built in HTML and CSS; it does not fetch live AQI through an application backend.

items.name: password-generator-and-validator
items.summary: A beginner Python exercise in input validation and random string generation.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Practices branching, input checking, and character-class rules in a Python command-line program.
An early programming exercise using basic randomness, not a password-security product.

items.name: Reiatsu
items.summary: A Windows wallpaper studio with desktop attachment, scene controls, and WebGL motion applied to still images.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Attaches wallpaper behind Windows desktop icons and offers a floating scene picker, tray controls, and playback settings.
Applies WebGL drift, refraction, and lighting to still images, with character-protection masks on selected scenes. These are animated stills, not reconstructed character animation.

items.name: MovieHelper
items.summary: A browser extension experiment for cast and character lookup over video players, with spoiler-aware presentation.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Uses AniList and TVmaze lookups, with optional TMDB configuration, to surface cast and character information.
Includes a spoiler-aware presentation mode and a video-player overlay. Website compatibility remains a prototype constraint.

items.name: Digital Twin Agent
items.summary: A local technical-activity collector that assembles a shareable context document through a redaction layer.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Collects technical activity into local event records and a generated context document.
Includes a redaction layer for sharing; exported content still needs review before publication.

items.name: AI Funding Radar
items.summary: A scheduled research tool that collects funding news, records sources, and produces a company digest.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Collects funding stories, company details, and source links into SQLite-backed digests.
Includes scheduled execution and a web interface; extracted funding facts still require source verification.

items.name: Remotion Demo Studio
items.summary: A code-first video studio with React compositions, storyboards, and a repository-to-demo workflow.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Uses React compositions and Remotion timelines to author repeatable demo videos.
Includes repository analysis, storyboard preparation, rendering, and review workflows.

items.name: JustHireMe Web
items.summary: A separate web edition extracted from the desktop workbench, retaining its React frontend and FastAPI backend.

details.title: Inside the project
bullets: Separates the React frontend and FastAPI backend from the Tauri packaging.
Retains profile-based job matching and reviewable application drafts as an independent web development track.
